snippet.title: Pumped BMX+ - All Formats Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Pumped BMX + uses the hit game 'Pumped BMX 2' as inspiration - taking everything which made the mobile version so successful and enhancing every aspect of it for console and PC.

Originally developed by one man studio Yeah Us!, Pumped BMX + sees players ride their way through increasingly challenging levels while pulling off crazy and impressive trick combinations. 

Pumped BMX is out on PC and all major consoles from September 18th!
